purpose: Teach: 勝てる/そろえ/置け/絞ら/読み直し/在り方/実装/低減

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、ライバル社に勝てる商品を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's get a product to market that beats the competition.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving opening. Clear directive tone. No hesitation—she's confident in the direction. Steady eye contact, slightly higher energy than the room baseline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料をそろえております
lines.en: Yes. I've got the documents ready.
lines.style: Efficient, attentive. Quick agreement without overstatement. Slight nod in the voice. Shows readiness without making it about himself.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員、資料を置けるロッカー、増やしますか
lines.en: Should we add more lockers for the staff to store their materials?
lines.style: Measured, consulting. Phrase as a genuine question—she's inviting input before deciding. Slight lift at the end, checking the room. Practical tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告予算を絞らせていただきました
lines.en: Yes. I've adjusted the advertising budget as requested.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact report. No pride in the cut, no apology either. Speaking to a decision already made. Even, competent delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案書を読み直して、再提出しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the proposal once more and resubmit it.
lines.style: Directive but not impatient. Slight emphasis on 'review'—quality check, not criticism. Assumes agreement. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議の在り方を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently reviewing how we run our meetings.
lines.style: Focused update. Taking initiative without waiting to be asked. Steady, professional tone. Shows he's already working on it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内SNSを実装しましょう
lines.en: Let's implement an internal SNS platform.
lines.style: Clear directive with forward momentum. Slight emphasis on 'implement'—this is decided. Brisk, efficient. No room for debate but not hostile.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫低減を進めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with inventory reduction.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Steady, measured. Closing tone—wrapping up the meeting's thread. Quiet competence. Slight emphasis on 'moving forward' shows progress.
